# ClinicFinderPH

> ClinicFinderPH is a directory of healthcare clinics in the Philippines. Browse and compare dental, pediatric, dermatology, OB-GYN, animal bite, and other clinics by location, services, prices, and PhilHealth accreditation.

Clinics are organized by type and by location (province and city). Each clinic page lists services, operating hours, contact details, ratings, and address. Patients can find PhilHealth-accredited clinics near them and send inquiries to participating clinics.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.clinicfinderph.com): Search and browse clinics across the Philippines
- [Locations](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/locations): Browse clinics by province and city
- [Animal Bite Centers](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/animal-bite-center): Find animal bite treatment centers and rabies vaccination
- [Blog](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/blog): Guides and articles on healthcare, costs, and clinics in the Philippines
- [For Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/for-clinics): Information for clinics that want to claim or list their profile
- [About](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/about): About ClinicFinderPH

## Clinic types

- [Dental Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/dental): Comprehensive dental care including general dentistry, orthodontics, cosmetic procedures, and oral surgery across the Philippines.
- [Pediatric Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/pediatric): Specialized healthcare for infants, children, and adolescents including vaccinations, developmental monitoring, and child wellness.
- [General Practice](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/general): Primary healthcare services for adults including consultations, preventive care, chronic disease management, and routine checkups.
- [Dermatology Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/dermatology): Expert skin care including acne treatment, cosmetic procedures, skin cancer screening, and medical dermatology services.
- [OB-GYN Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/obgyn): Women's health specialists providing prenatal care, gynecology services, family planning, and obstetric care.
- [Eye Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/ophthalmology): Comprehensive eye care including eye exams, vision correction, cataract surgery, LASIK, and treatment of eye conditions.
- [ENT Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/ent): Ear, nose, and throat specialists treating sinus conditions, hearing problems, throat disorders, and related conditions.
- [Physical Therapy Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/physical-therapy): Rehabilitation services including sports injury recovery, post-surgery rehab, mobility treatment, and pain management.
- [Psychology & Psychiatry](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/psychology): Mental health services including counseling, psychiatric care, therapy sessions, and mental wellness support.
- [Orthopedic Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/orthopedic): Orthopedic clinics specializing in musculoskeletal conditions, bone and joint care, sports injuries, and physical rehabilitation across the Philippines.
- [Rural Health Units](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/rural-health-unit): Government-operated primary care facilities serving rural communities with basic health services, maternal care, immunizations, and PhilHealth-accredited programs.
- [Health Centers](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/health-center): Barangay and community health centers providing preventive care, basic consultations, family planning, and public health programs.
- [Diagnostic Centers](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/diagnostic): Diagnostic centers offering laboratory tests, imaging services, X-ray, ultrasound, and comprehensive health screenings across the Philippines.
- [Veterinary Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/veterinary): Veterinary clinics and animal hospitals providing pet care, vaccinations, surgery, and wellness services across the Philippines.
- [Government Hospitals](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/government-hospital): Public hospitals including district, provincial, and regional medical centers offering inpatient care, emergency services, and specialized treatments.
- [Municipal Health Offices](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/municipal-health-office): City and municipal health offices coordinating public health programs, providing primary care consultations, and managing community health initiatives.
- [Birthing & Lying-In Clinics](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/birthing-clinic): Government birthing facilities and lying-in clinics providing prenatal care, safe delivery services, postnatal care, and newborn screening.
- [Child Development & Therapy Centers](https://www.clinicfinderph.com/child-development): Centers providing therapy and developmental support for children — ABA therapy, occupational therapy, speech therapy, SPED support, and developmental assessment for autism, ADHD, and developmental delays.
